summary: One-click Markdown clipper. Save pages and selections as clean Markdown with images, frontmatter, preview, copy, and download.
singlePurpose: Convert the current webpage or selected content into Markdown and let the user preview, copy, or download the result.

permissions.name: activeTab
permissions.justification: Temporarily accesses the current tab only after the user clicks the extension or selects an extension context menu action, so the page can be converted to Markdown.

permissions.name: contextMenus
permissions.justification: Adds right-click actions so users can clip selected webpage content as Markdown.

permissions.name: downloads
permissions.justification: Saves user-requested Markdown files or ZIP files containing Markdown and local image assets.

permissions.name: offscreen
permissions.justification: Creates Blob URLs for Markdown and ZIP downloads because Manifest V3 service workers cannot create DOM Blob object URLs.

permissions.name: scripting
permissions.justification: Runs the Markdown clipping script only after the user invokes the extension on the current tab.

permissions.name: storage
permissions.justification: Stores the user's Images and Template clipping preferences so popup and context menu actions use the same options.

remoteCode.justification: The extension does not use remote code. All executable JavaScript and CSS is included in the submitted package.

screenshots.title: Clip a selection from the context menu
